body: Vimal Kejriwal (MD & CEO) on 2025-07-29 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "FY '27, obviously, we should have at least a 50 to 100 basis points improvement in that. So FY '27, we will be probably reaching closer to 10%" Metric: Consolidated EBITDA margin. Target: ~9-10%. Deadline: 2027-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: moved-goalpost. Evidence: See fy27-ebitda-9pct-plus: re-dated to FY28 (Jan-26), then FY29 for double digit (May-26), without reference to this statement.
